instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot from behind. Inside a judo dojo with training equipment on the left, the young man in the white gi (R2) is seen from behind in the foreground, wearing a black belt. He is grappling with the woman in the blue gi (R1) on the left, who has her hair in a bun. R1's right arm is hooked over R2's shoulder as they practice a throw. Soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the contrast between the white and blue uniforms against the warm beige wall.
